verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>闻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>荒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>凉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sān</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>亩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>葡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>萄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>罢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bà</rt></ruby><ruby>特<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tè</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>贺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hè</rt></ruby><ruby>梅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>谷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>伊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>粮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>祸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Huò</rt></ruby><ruby>哉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby>！<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>清<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>浓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>深<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>烧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>筵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>琴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qín</rt></ruby>，<ruby>鼓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>击<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>鼓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>吹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuī</rt></ruby><ruby>笛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>饮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>顾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>掳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>贵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>饥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>饿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby>，<ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qún</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby><ruby>渴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gù</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>阴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>扩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuò</rt></ruby><ruby>张<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>欲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>限<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>、<ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qún</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>繁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>贱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>压<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>；<ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>贵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>降<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>降<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>崇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby>；<ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>草<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>草<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>场<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>丰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>肥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">féi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>场<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>游<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>祸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Huò</rt></ruby><ruby>哉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby>！<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>假<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>绳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>！<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>套<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tào</rt></ruby><ruby>绳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>避<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby><ruby>剑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>鞘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>弦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xián</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>弓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby><ruby>兵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yī</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>雇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>达<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>弓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>箭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>余<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>剩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>达<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>勇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>稀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>少<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>异<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>象<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>默<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>：<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>顶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

verses.text: <ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>呐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>喧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>哗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>邑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>跑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>弓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>箭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>捆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>绑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>找<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>捆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>绑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>痛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>哭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby>。<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby>（<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>竭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>慰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby>“<ruby>异<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>象<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby>”<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>溃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuì</rt></ruby><ruby>乱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luàn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>践<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>踏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tà</rt></ruby>、<ruby>烦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>扰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。<ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>破<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>哀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>达<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>箭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>袋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>战<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>车<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chē</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>兵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bīnɡ</rt></ruby>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>吉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jí</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>揭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>盾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dùn</rt></ruby><ruby>牌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>嘉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>谷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>遍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>战<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>车<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chē</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>兵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>排<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>誓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby>返<ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby>：<ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>膝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>跪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>拜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby>；<ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>誓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，‘<ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>乎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hu</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>；<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>裔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>夸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuā</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>。’”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>屈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ní</rt></ruby><ruby>波<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bō</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>弯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wān</rt></ruby><ruby>腰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yāo</rt></ruby>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>偶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>驮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuó</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>抬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>驮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>疲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pí</rt></ruby><ruby>乏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fá</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wān</rt></ruby><ruby>腰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yāo</rt></ruby><ruby>屈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>驮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>掳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>余<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>剩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>抱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>胎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tāi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>怀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huái</rt></ruby><ruby>搋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuāi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fà</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huái</rt></ruby><ruby>搋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuāi</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>保<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>抱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>怀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huái</rt></ruby><ruby>抱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>拯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>囊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>抓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuā</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>雇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>匠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>俯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>伏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>叩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kòu</rt></ruby><ruby>拜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby>。
